name: secure-workflow-guide
description: Guides through Trail of Bits' 5-step secure development workflow. Runs Slither scans, checks special features (upgradeability/ERC conformance/token integration), generates visual security diagrams, helps document security properties for fuzzing/verification, and reviews manual security areas. Use when securing a smart contract end to end rather than hunting one bug, checking a project on every check-in or before deployment, triaging a Slither report, or asking where to start on smart contract se
author: trailofbits
summary_zh: 一套智能合约全流程安全开发指南，适合持续检查、上线前审计、分析扫描报告及规划模糊测试与形式化验证。
